text:
Aisha: quick async check-in — where do we stand on the hotpath work for this sprint? specifically: kernel patch + continuous batching rollout + KV warmup heuristics. any blockers or ownership ambiguity?

Jordan: kernel PR is landed in `runtime/kernel/hotpath-opt` but not merged to `main` yet. needs 1 more perf review and an SRE signoff. canary on 4 nodes yesterday showed ~6% median latency win, p99 regressed by ~50ms in one trace. PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/1234

Luis: infra note — autoscaler policy needs a small change for batching burst behavior. I put a draft change in infra repo: `infra/autoscaler/config.yaml` snippet: ```
burst_window: 30
scale_up_rate: 2
scale_down_delay: 45
```
This prevents overscaling for short bursty prefixes. I can land before canary if we want.

Maya: ownership question — who will own the fallback path if kernel causes p99 spikes? we should add a feature-flagged fallback to the routing layer (so Dedicated customers stay within SLA). I can own the routing change but need someone to own the rollback playbook. @Jordan?

Jordan: I can own rollback playbook + kernel revert procedure. suggest we add automated metric-based rollback: if p99 > baseline + 100ms for >5min, then flip flag.

Sam: heads-up — my quantization experiments (related to the kernel patch) show slight token distribution drift on some opt models. we need an eval run on the golden prompts before wide rollout. i'll queue the eval today, ETA 6h.

Priya: pinging for code review on the kernel PR from infra and platform reviewers — can reviewers please prioritize? small checklist: unit tests passing, microbench numbers attached, rollback steps documented.

deploy-bot: canary scheduled: 2187660000 (2026-03-18T14:30:00Z) — targets: runtime-hotpath-canary, nodes=4. Notify #eng-oncall for observation.

Luis: infra risk: if autoscaler lands after canary, we may see transient overscale. strongly recommend we land `burst_window` tweak before canary.

Aisha: OK action items I have noted: 
- Jordan: finalize perf review and document rollback + flip-flag rules (owner: Jordan)
- Priya: follow up on code reviews (owner: Priya)
- Sam: run eval suite on golden prompts (owner: Sam)
- Luis: land autoscaler config tweak or coordinate canary timing (owner: Luis)
- Maya: add routing feature flag and test harness (owner: Maya)
Please update status by EOD. If anyone expects >24h delay, call it out now. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

Jordan: will post perf graphs and the rollback playbook within 2h.

Priya: looping in @eng-oncall for observation window, leaving a short playbook snippet in PR description.

Sam: eval results queued, linking results here when done.

Maya: I'll add the feature-flag toggle in the routing config and a smoke test.

Aisha: thanks — tagging this as the canonical async status thread for the sprint hotpath. we'll do a quick 15m sync if anything fails during canary. :white_check_mark:
